description.p: ChipCutter is an offline desktop Computer-Aided Manufacturing (CAM) application and headless CLI written in Rust that converts 3D STEP B-Rep models, triangle meshes (STL, OBJ, 3MF), 2D DXF/SVG vector drawings, and built-in parametric 2D sketches into verified CNC milling, routing, V-carving, and 4th-axis rotary G-code.

ul.li: Exact f64 B-Rep, mesh, and 2D vector toolpath generation with true circular arc preservation
2.5D Facing, 2D Contour with tabs, 2D Pocket, Adaptive roughing, Rest Machining, Drilling, Helical Bore, Chamfer, Trace, and V-Carving
3-axis surface milling (Waterline, Parallel, Scallop, Pencil) and 4th-axis indexed/wrapped/simultaneous rotary milling
Interactive 3D stock-removal simulation with rapid-into-stock and gouge verification
Configurable GRBL, grblHAL ATC, and LinuxCNC G-code post-processors plus headless CLI batch builds

screenshot.caption: ChipCutter 3D CAM workspace with toolpath preview and operation inspector
Interactive stock-removal simulation with animated cutter and holder
Adaptive clearing and rest machining toolpaths

description.p: GUI polish and illustrated documentation release: unified collapsible card styling across the CAM Browser and right-side Inspectors, strict two-column Inspector layouts, consistent eyeball (visibility) vs. checkbox (active/inactive) semantics, universal hover tooltips across all controls, faster Error Heatmap meshing and playback deferral with clear toggle controls, an unsaved-changes confirmation dialog on window close, and an illustrated Sample Projects Gallery with per-operation completion screenshots.

Added selectable Tri-Dexel 3D volumetric CAM simulation alongside fast 2.5D heightmap simulation, quantitative stock-vs-target error-volume and RMS/MAE/P95/P99 surface deviation metrics, signed deviation Error Heatmap visualization, CLI --engine/--tolerance JSON benchmarking, and illustrated Tutorial 17.
Bug-fix release: reset all active project, model, simulation, G-code preview, and cached geometry state cleanly when opening or switching projects.

Added non-destructive per-model orientation, lay-flat, scaling, target-size fitting, and positioning for STEP solids and STL/OBJ/3MF meshes (GUI Model Transform Inspector, Mesh Import orientation preview, CLI transform-model, and associative Ctrl+R reload preservation), Setup WCS fine Z-axis clocking, and illustrated Tutorial 16.

Security hardening release: read-only built-in post-processors, sanitized G-code output paths and metadata, cumulative zip-bomb and parser complexity caps, private temporary extraction directories, and SHA-pinned release workflows.

Added Machine Definitions and per-machine tool libraries (Generic, Millennium Machines Milo v1.5 LDO Kit, Makera Carvera Air), upgrade-safe cloning and .machine.toml export/import, machine envelope/RPM diagnostics, and the Help -> About dialog.
Initial release of ChipCutter with 2.5D milling, 3-axis mesh finishing, 4th-axis rotary toolpaths, stock-removal simulation, and verified GRBL/LinuxCNC G-code post-processing.
